open_points.subject: Model M04 — PhotoPlacement.name
open_points.text: `name` is the name M02 gave the source when it was placed
open_points.question: What is M02, which M02 field supplies `PhotoPlacement.name`, and which M02 instance is used when the same project and source content appear under more than one relative name?
options: Copy the name from the specific M02 record supplied to the first successful delivery.
Choose one of the M02 records for that content independently of which record the caller supplied.
Derive the name again from the source path during delivery rather than copying it from M02.
open_points.default_guess: Copy the name from the specific M02 record supplied to the first successful delivery and preserve it permanently.

witness.initial: One project contains two source paths, `a/photo.jpg` and `b/photo.jpg`, with identical content, and scanning represents both with M02 records.
events: The caller asks the deliverer to place the photo represented by the M02 record named `b/photo.jpg`.
The deliverer mints the single placement allowed for that project and source content.
outcomes: The placement permanently records `b/photo.jpg` because the delivered M02 instance supplies the name.
The placement permanently records `a/photo.jpg` because the implementation selects or re-derives a name for the content.
witness.observer: The caller and any Portal reader displaying the placement name.
